title: Choose Safarnama's visual world
question: Your steer leads: Painted Signboard, disciplined into official railway signwriting. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Railway Enamel Signs
options.lineage: Indian Railways' own signwriting: enamel station plaques, painted platform numbers, stencilled coach lettering
options.thesis: Signboard boldness with railway discipline: big bilingual lettering on flat enamel panels, two colours doing all the work, nothing decorative.
options.viewport: Home: an indigo enamel panel with SAFARNAMA / सफ़रनामा lettered in yellow at sign scale, the search form below as a white plate with stencilled labels; Plan-a-trip and Explore as two smaller plates.
options.risk: Two colours at full strength can feel heavy over many screens; the white plates must carry the long tasks.

raised.raise: No borders, flourishes, rainbows or painted ornament: colour only as flat panels, the way railway signs are made.
Type does the work: scale contrast between sign-size lettering and quiet UI text replaces every decorative device.
Each section gets one panel colour at full strength (search indigo, wallet green, planner yellow) so you always know where you are.
One reserved colour per meaning: vermilion only for alerts and waitlists, never for decoration.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.lineage: printed travel ticket wallets with tear-off coupons
options.thesis: Every journey is a wallet of coupons: one leg per sheet, stamped confirmed, used or cancelled.
options.viewport: Home as an open ticket wallet with the search as the first coupon; results as a stack of tear-off legs.
options.case: Very clear for bookings, tickets and refunds (stamped states); weaker as an Indian identity, it reads as vintage airline.
options.risk: Charming on tickets, but forced on search, maps and the planner.

options.label: Design Annual Plates
options.thesis: A gallery of printed plates with registration marks.
options.viewport: A near-white sheet of framed plates.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a gallery, not a booking tool, and nothing Indian.
options.risk: Pale and quiet on a big classroom screen.
options.kept: Hairline precision on rules and dividers.

options.label: Vertical Media Feed
options.thesis: One item fills the screen; flick to the next.
options.viewport: A destination fills the screen with actions down the side.
options.case: Fuses poorly: booking needs comparison, not one item at a time.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What Indian travel booking apps ship (ixigo, MakeMyTrip style), executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A blue header band with the search box, then cards of offers and popular routes.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
